body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> The Etón presented its ultra-portable and self-powered radio 'Microlink FR160' at CES 2009, which offers AM/FM reception and access to all seven NOAA All-Hazard Channels.
Additional features include a flashlight and cell phone charging capabilities as well as a new sleekly designed water-resistant housing.
The retail price for this unit is $30 and it will be available in the first quarter of 2009.
< AVING Special Report Team for 'CES 2009' : Idea Kim, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Paul Shin, Miso Kim, Esther Yoon, Abraham Shim, Grace Won, Risa Koo, JB Shim, Jini Shim >
